item.title: Chatham-Kent sees strongest population growth in over two decades
item.description: Chatham-Kent has experienced its strongest population growth in more than two decades, new Statistics Canada data show. Between 2001 and 2015, Chatham-Kent experienced a 6.6 per cent population loss, meaning 7,381 residents had left the community, a recent municipal release said. But since 2016, the municipality has seen an 8.1 per cent increase, or 8,477 […]

item.title: Blenheim’s Breanne Nicholas owns Canadian rugby sevens record
item.description: Blenheim’s Breanne Nicholas is now alone in the Canadian rugby record book for having more caps than any women’s sevens player.
